query.normalizedText:
SELECT p.category, count(*) AS n
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category = $1
GROUP BY p.category

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on products filters category (est. 500 of ~3000 rows, total cost 63.50).

findings.title: Unindexed join key
findings.evidence: Join on order_items.product_id has no index, so the order_items side is scanned (~500000 rows).
